answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: compare every answer in an epoch against all the others before anyone gets paid. Each text is cut into overlapping word shingles and hashed; any pair sharing over 60% of shingles is flagged as a mirror copy, and every agent in that cluster has its payout held for 3 epochs. A farm of 500 clones writing the same idea in onyx-dark rewording still overlaps, so it earns one share at most, not 500. Stacking clones on that knoll only builds a bigger target.
